title: JPKCom Desktop — Changelog
description: Releases and news of JPKCom Desktop. Item links are relative to this file.

items.title: JPKCom Desktop 1.4.0 released
items.summary: Updates of the offline copy no longer hold back a new version, the holidays work offline, and the offline copy repairs itself. Plus two desktops on one site whose names overlap keep their settings apart.
items.content_text: JPKCom Desktop 1.4.0 fixes the service worker and the storage of several desktops on one site. See the changelog for the details.

items.title: JPKCom Desktop 1.3.0 released
items.summary: Your icon set can replace the desktop's own glyphs, code keeps its colours in the Reader, and banners show the app an article opens in. Plus a start language that follows your browser and dock pins that follow renamed apps.
items.content_text: JPKCom Desktop 1.3.0 brings fine-tuning from moving a real site onto the desktop. See the changelog for the details.

items.title: JPKCom Desktop 1.2.0 released
items.summary: Feeds and site data are fresh again with the fast start, sites can bring their own icon sets, and the terminal reads manual pages per entry and language. Plus web windows anywhere on the site and a Fortune app you can rename.
items.content_text: JPKCom Desktop 1.2.0 keeps data fresh and brings more for site owners. See the changelog for the details.

items.title: JPKCom Desktop 1.1.0 released
items.summary: A faster start: windows load their code when they first open, and a repeat visit starts from the offline copy. Plus a house theme, apps with their own texts and a live demo.
items.content_text: JPKCom Desktop 1.1.0 starts faster and brings more for site owners. See the changelog for the details.

items.title: JPKCom Desktop 1.0.0 released
items.summary: The first public release: windows, menu bar, Dock, apps and modules — any number of languages, a strict Content Security Policy and no build step.
items.content_text: The first public release of JPKCom Desktop. See the changelog for everything it brings.

items.title: An example site to start from
items.summary: Pages, bookmarks, a showcase with one example of every kind of item, fortunes and this feed — ready to be replaced with your own content.
items.content_text: The example content in the site folder shows every feature of the manifest.
